sourceNotes.rawContent: Elevate your style with this stunning rose gold-toned tennis bracelet, featuring a brilliant solitaire crystal. Perfect for adding high-fashion glamour to any outfit. To preserve its radiant finish and sparkle, we recommend keeping it away from moisture and perfumes, and storing it in a dry place after every wear.

notes: category: "bracelets" is a PROPOSAL, not source data — the source had no category. Basis: the title and description both describe the piece as a bracelet, and the original category label was "Bracelet under ₹99". Requires explicit owner confirmation at review.
